## Patches use their sqlite table end-to-end: qname keys fix the CASCADE loss at… — 2026-07-25 (parent f6e3e069499c)

The patches table schema (`SCHEMA_SQL`, `SCHEMA_VERSION` bumped to v9) is re-keyed on `qname TEXT` instead of a foreign-key reference to the symbols table, eliminating the silent CASCADE loss that occurred whenever `replace_file_symbols` recycled symbol rows during a graph refresh.

Key store changes:
- `Store.add_patch` now keys by qname; `require_symbol=False` bypasses the existence check (used by `patch_create_cmd` for `--gone` deletes)
- New `Store.mark_patches_applied` seals rows with `applied=1` and a session note; new `Store.delete_applied_patches` clears them
- `Store._get_patches_by_symbol_id` and `Store.patch_count_for_symbol` removed; `Store._patch_row_to_dict` added
- `record_intent` now calls `mark_patches_applied` instead of writing `.pending.md`; `_run_digest_write` calls `delete_applied_patches` instead of `consume_intent`
- `trie/pending_intent` module deleted entirely (`append_intent`, `consume_intent`, `read_intent`, and helpers all removed)
- `_covered_qnames` and `collect_session_diff` read sealed/unsealed store rows instead of the pending-intent file
- Tests `test_patches_cascaded_on_symbol_delete` and `test_patch_count_for_symbol` replaced by `test_patches_survive_symbol_replacement` and `test_patch_rows_are_qname_keyed`
